tagline.en: A WhatsApp API gateway — turns the account into REST plus webhooks, for n8n and Home Assistant to use
tagline.pt: Gateway de API do WhatsApp — transforma a conta em REST + webhooks, pro n8n e o Home Assistant usarem

notes.en:
### Behaviour change in 0.15.0

While WhatsApp Web reloads its own page — measured around five minutes after a
fresh pairing — every engine route answers `409` instead of the raw `500` it
used to. A client that retries on 5xx and gives up on 4xx will now fail where
it used to recover, so check the flows that call this API.
notes.pt:
### Mudança de comportamento na 0.15.0

Enquanto o WhatsApp Web recarrega a própria página — medido em torno de cinco
minutos depois de um pareamento novo — todas as rotas do engine respondem `409`
em vez do `500` cru de antes. Cliente que tenta de novo em 5xx e desiste em 4xx
vai falhar onde antes se recuperava, então vale conferir os fluxos que chamam
essa API.

openwa-master-key.note: The master key every API call carries in `X-Api-Key`. Set here so the key is deterministic; left empty, OpenWA generates one at first boot and only shows it in the startup banner and data/.api-key.

openwa-key-pepper.note: Server-side pepper for hashing the API keys (HMAC-SHA256 instead of plain SHA-256). Changing it later invalidates every key already issued, so it is generated at install time rather than added afterwards.
